task:
Open the file /home/user/Documents/product_launch.pptx in LibreOffice Impress. This is a 5-slide product launch presentation for 'Widget Pro'.

Make the following modifications:

1. On Slide 1 (title 'Widget Pro'), change the subtitle from 'Launch Date: March 2025' to 'Launch Date: June 2025'.

2. On Slide 2 (title 'Key Features'), add a new bullet point 'AI-powered recommendations' after the existing bullet points. The existing bullets are: 'Real-time analytics dashboard', 'Cross-platform compatibility', 'Enterprise-grade security', '24/7 customer support'.

3. On Slide 3 (title 'Pricing'), change the text '$49.99/month' to '$39.99/month' in the first bullet. The first bullet should read 'Starter Plan: $39.99/month'.

4. On Slide 4 (title 'Go-to-Market Strategy'), add speaker notes: 'Emphasize the 30-day free trial offer.'

5. On Slide 5, change the title from 'Thank You' to 'Thank You & Next Steps'. Add a new line of body text: 'Visit widgetpro.com for early access.'

Save the file (Ctrl+S).

verification.description: Slide 1 contains updated launch date 'Launch Date: June 2025'
Slide 2 still contains original bullet 'Real-time analytics dashboard'
Slide 4 notes contain 'Emphasize the 30-day free trial offer'
Slide 5 contains updated title 'Thank You & Next Steps'
Slide 5 contains new body text about early access
